Sunny Deol's 'Mother India, Aunt Pakistan' remark sparks controversy

Actor and politician Sunny Deol's statement, "Bharat Maa hai aur Pakistan Mousi" (India is Mother and Pakistan is Aunt), has caused a stir. The remark was made in the context of his father Dharmendra's views on the Partition of India. Deol's comment has drawn attention and discussion.
